evals.prompt: Create a QA test plan for PROJ-69209
evals.expected_output: A plan.md file created at qa-test-plans/PROJ-69209/plan.md containing test cases derived from the story's acceptance criteria, with all TCs set to Pending status and concrete steps referencing AcmeSync sync jobs and DB queries.

assertions.name: has-test-cases
assertions.description: plan.md contains at least one TC-01 heading

assertions.name: has-progress-line
assertions.description: plan.md contains the Progress summary line

assertions.name: all-pending-status
assertions.description: No test cases are marked as Pass or Fail on a newly created plan

assertions.name: has-acceptance-criteria
assertions.description: plan.md contains an Acceptance Criteria section

evals.prompt: Persist the QA test plan for PROJ-68433 to disk
evals.expected_output: A plan.md file written at qa-test-plans/PROJ-68433/plan.md using data already available in session context (from memory), containing TC-01 through TC-09 with the open questions and SQL snippets from the grooming session.

assertions.name: has-open-questions
assertions.description: plan.md has an Open Questions section

assertions.name: tc10-skipped
assertions.description: TC-10 is marked as Skipped (out of scope)

evals.prompt: Mark TC-03 as blocked on PROJ-68433. The RAM test clients don't have virtual tour URLs configured in AcmeSync, so we can't run this test yet.
evals.expected_output: The existing qa-test-plans/PROJ-68433/plan.md is updated: TC-03 status changes from Pending to Blocked, the blocking reason is captured in the Notes field, and the Progress summary line reflects the change.

assertions.name: tc03-status-blocked
assertions.description: TC-03 status is updated to Blocked in the persisted file

assertions.name: blocking-reason-captured
assertions.description: Notes on TC-03 mention the test client / RAM issue

assertions.name: progress-updated
assertions.description: Progress line reflects at least 1 Blocked

assertions.name: tc03-not-pending
assertions.description: TC-03 section no longer shows Pending status (file was actually modified on disk)
assertions.description_detail: The TC-03 Status line must not contain Pending — verifies disk write happened, not just a verbal response

evals.prompt: Resume the PROJ-68433 test plan. Where are we?
evals.expected_output: Reads the existing plan.md from disk and shows current status: story name, progress count, a table of all test cases with their current statuses, and highlights any blocked or open items.

assertions.name: reads-from-disk
assertions.description: Response includes content that could only come from the persisted file (TC-01 through TC-09, open questions)

assertions.name: shows-progress
assertions.description: Response includes a status summary or progress indicator

assertions.name: highlights-blocked
assertions.description: Response surfaces the blocked TC-03 (from eval-3)

evals.expected_output: Scans the qa-test-plans/ directory and shows a table of all stories with plan.md files, including story key, title, and current progress counts.

assertions.name: shows-progress-counts
assertions.description: Response includes progress counts or status indicators
